technology: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company 28-nanometer local reconstruction
boundary: Actual serial dispatcher through batch selection and command admission into all five compute groups.
proven_behavior: Every actual group command acceptance equals its batch launch handshake, including group zero through the residual-bank arbiter.
A group can launch only once per batch and only when its bit was requested by the current command.
Single-group requests select the descriptor target; batch requests use payload bits4:0 only when reserved header bits63:5 are zero. Invalid or empty masks cannot launch a group.
The physical descriptor mode is clear while the batch is idle, implies batch opcode7 when set, and agrees with the opcode during execution.

Every accepted320-bit group descriptor equals its correct slice of the currently accepted serial-header words: bits319:0 for single-group opcode6, or bits(383+320*group):(64+320*group) for batch opcode7.
The coupled serial and batch invariant survives actual mapped reset, clock and optional local asynchronous-reset updates. Initial resetless payload values remain arbitrary.
independent_audit: Independently reconstructed the full serial/batch invariant and history successors, genuinely renamed all state/input/history variables, and rechecked exact payload ordering, current physical identity, mask decoding, reset/clock/asynchronous preservation, unique requested launch and all five current-header descriptor properties.
diagnostic_corrections: Initial counterexamples identified omitted parent/arbiter state, reserved-header rejection and unreachable stale-mode cases in the proposed invariant. The final lifetime clauses were checked by original-equation induction. No mapped circuit or running workload was changed.
